description.narrative: Edvantage Group Holdings Limited (Edvantage or the Company) is a leading private sector higher and vocational education group in the Peoples Republic of China (the PRC or China) with key presence in Sichuan province, a frontier province in Western China, and Guangdong province. Edvantage provides private higher educational services including technical and vocational education, and other services to approximately 86,100 students, as of August 31, 2023, across nine colleges and educational institutions in China, Australia and Singapore. Shares of Edvantage are listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. IFC is proposing to invest up to US$100 million equivalent in the form of a senior loan to Guangzhou Zhiheng Education Consulting Co., Ltd. (an indirect subsidiary of the Company) as the borrower, which will primarily be used to support the Companys capital expenditure plan to build new buildings and facilities in its flagship colleges in Sichuan and Guangdong provinces.

The most significant expected project-level effect is stakeholder effect through improved access to affordable and quality higher education and vocational education services in the PRC. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates that the investment will strengthen the competitiveness of higher education and vocational education markets in the PRC. The Company will demonstrate its innovative model of integration of industry and education, tailored to market needs and employment trends. Significant movements by other private education providers are expected, along with the governments policies to promote higher-quality vocational education system.
